column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” and מָעוֹז־ (“the stronghold”) is rendered “the strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have asked” is rendered “I have desired,” and בְּנֹעַם־ (“the pleasantness”) “the beauty.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּסֻכֹּה (“his shelter”) is rendered “His pavilion,” and “tent” “tabernacle.”
The Hebrew is compressed (“to you my heart said, ‘Seek my face’”); NKJV restructures it as “When You said, ‘Seek My face,’ My heart said to You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for” is rendered “When,” and יַאַסְפֵנִי (“gather me in”) “will take care of me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a witness of violence” is rendered “such as breathe out violence.”
The Hebrew sentence is incomplete (“If I had not believed…”); NKJV supplies “I would have lost heart.”
